log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national-1 quick morning. Strategy: kill national daily (no info leak), avoid source-only victims until we see L's pool announcements (day 3). I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon). Sources I follow: regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union.

Day2: killed national-1 quick morning again. Still avoiding source-only victims until the day 3 press conference gives pool info. I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon). I follow regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union.

Day3: killed national-1 quick morning. Still avoiding source-only victims until press conference info arrives. I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon). I follow regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Kill national only (safe) and watch the pool announced after day 3 to see which L traits are active; if the pool stays near 10M, L probably sees little, and I can kill source victims gradually.

Day4: killed national-1 and regional-1 (quick, morning) to probe whether L traces sources. Pool was 10M after day 3 (no leaks from national-only kills). Check the day-6 press conference: if the pool drops to about 2-3M, regional is traced (a 3x lie is possible, so confirm). I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), following regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Keep kills in morning/afternoon. Add one new source per 3-day window so any leak can be attributed.

Day5: killed national-1 and regional-1 and web-1 (quick, morning/afternoon). I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), following regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Keep all kills in morning/afternoon, never evening/night. Pool was 10M after day 3. Day-6 press conference covers days 4-5 (regional kills on day 4 and 5, web on day 5): if the pool drops to about 2-3M or about 7M (25% region -> 2.5M if traced), regional is traced; if it drops to about 7M, web is traced (30% follow). A 3x lie is possible, so confirm with the next conference. Stay below 300k: avoid leaking too many sources at once.

I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), following regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Keep all kills in morning/afternoon, never evening/night. Pool was 10M after day 3 (conference every 3 days; the next is after day 6). Kills so far: national daily, regional on days 4-5, web on day 5. Day 6: killed national-1 plus one victim from each of the sources I had not used much, all quick in morning/afternoon. Interpret the day-6 pool: ~10M means no leaks. If it drops to ~2.5M, regional is traced, and if to ~3M, web is traced. A 3x lie is possible, so confirm with the next conference. Stay well above 300k: avoid leaking many sources at once. Prefer national kills (leak nothing) and be sparing with source-only kills.

I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), following regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Keep all kills in morning/afternoon. Conferences: day0 10M, day3 10M, day6 2M (could be a 3x lie; the true value may be 667k-6M). The leak is likely regional alone (2.5M, or less after trimming), or web, or timing plus another. Since day 6 I have killed only national-1 each day, quick in the morning, to avoid new leaks. Next conference is after day 9. If it still shows about 2M or less, stay with national only. If it jumps to 10M, the earlier reading was a lie, and source kills can resume carefully. The 300k threshold is the danger.
